country_event = {
	id = cosmo_brothelspy_events.990
	title = cosmo_brothelspy_events.990.t
	desc = cosmo_brothelspy_events.990.d
	picture = cosmogfx_OFFICIAL_PAPAL_STATES_1_eventPicture

	hidden = yes

	trigger = {
		ai = no
		has_country_flag = cosmo_spying_here
		NOT = {
			has_country_flag = cosmo_spy_event_fire
		}
		}
		
		immediate = {
			hidden_effect = {
				clr_country_flag = cosmo_spying_here					
				set_country_flag = cosmo_spy_event_fire					
				}
				}

		mean_time_to_happen = {
			days = 1
		}				

	option = {#new spy
		name = cosmo_brothelspy_events.990.38
		country_event = {
			id = cosmo_brothelspy_events.900
			}																									
	}

#repeater event
country_event = {
	id = cosmo_brothelspy_events.2003
	title = cosmo_brothelspy_events.2003.t
	desc = cosmo_brothelspy_events.2003.d
	picture = cosmogfx_OFFICIAL_GERMAN_1_eventPicture

					


	
	trigger = {
		has_country_flag = cosmo_spy_persistant_affair
		NOT = {
			has_country_modifier = having_an_persistant_spy
		}
		}

	mean_time_to_happen = {
	days = 1
	}
	
	
		immediate = {
			hidden_effect = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = {
							any_known_country = {
								ai = no
								reverse_has_opinion_modifier = {
									who = ROOT
									modifier = cosmo_spy_persistant_opinion
								}								
							}
						}
					}
					clr_country_flag = cosmo_spy_persistant_affair
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_known_country = {
							ai = no
							reverse_has_opinion_modifier = {
								who = ROOT
								modifier = cosmo_spy_persistant_opinion
							}								
						}
					}
					random_known_country = {
						limit = {
							reverse_has_opinion_modifier = {
								who = ROOT
								modifier = cosmo_spy_persistant_opinion
							}
						}
							save_event_target_as = spycountry
						}
						add_opinion = {
							who = spycountry
							modifier = cosmo_spy_persistant_opinion
						}
				}											
				}
				}

	option = {#send prostitute
		name = cosmo_brothelspy_events.2003.a
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						any_known_country = {
							ai = no
							reverse_has_opinion_modifier = {
								who = ROOT
								modifier = cosmo_spy_persistant_opinion
							}								
						}
					}
				}
				clr_country_flag = cosmo_spy_persistant_affair
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					any_known_country = {
						ai = no
						reverse_has_opinion_modifier = {
							who = ROOT
							modifier = cosmo_spy_persistant_opinion
						}								
					}
				}
				add_country_modifier = { 
					name = having_an_persistant_spy
					duration = 120  
					hidden = yes

				}				
				event_target:spycountry = {
					country_event = {
						id = cosmo_brothelspy_events.2004
						days = 5
						random = 35	
						}						
				}				
			}																											
	}				
}

# seduce monarch opinion clear
country_event = {
	id = cosmo_brothelspy_events.81
	title = cosmo_brothelspy_events.81.t
	desc = cosmo_brothelspy_events.81.d
	picture = {
	trigger = {
	NOT = {
				culture_group = japanese_g				
		}
			}	
	picture = COURT_eventPicture
	}	
	picture = {
	trigger = {
				culture_group = japanese_g				
			}	
	picture = cosmogfx_OOKU_GENERAL_8_eventPicture
	}
	


	trigger = {
		ai = no
		any_known_country = {
				has_opinion_modifier = {
					who = ROOT
					modifier = cosmo_seduced_monarch
				}
			OR = {
				NOT = {
					has_ruler_flag = cosmo_monarch_seduced
				}
			}	
		}
		}


	immediate = {
	hidden_effect = {
		random_known_country = {
			limit = {
			has_opinion_modifier = {
				who = ROOT
				modifier = cosmo_seduced_monarch
			}
			OR = {
				NOT = {
					has_ruler_flag = cosmo_monarch_seduced
				}
			}					
			}
			remove_opinion = {
				who = ROOT
				modifier = cosmo_seduced_monarch
			}
		}
		}
		}		
		
		mean_time_to_happen = {
			days = 1
		}

	option = { #artist
		name = cosmo_brothelspy_events.81.a	
																																																
	}							
}

# seduce cardinal opinion clear
country_event = {
	id = cosmo_brothelspy_events.82
	title = cosmo_brothelspy_events.82.t
	desc = cosmo_brothelspy_events.82.d
	picture = {
	trigger = {
	NOT = {
				culture_group = japanese_g				
		}
			}	
	picture = COURT_eventPicture
	}	
	picture = {
	trigger = {
				culture_group = japanese_g				
			}	
	picture = cosmogfx_OOKU_GENERAL_8_eventPicture
	}
	


	trigger = {
		ai = no
		any_known_country = {
				has_opinion_modifier = {
					who = ROOT
					modifier = cosmo_seduced_cardinal
				}
			OR = {
					any_owned_province = {
						has_province_flag = cosmo_has_seduced_cardinal
						has_cardinal = no						
					}
			}	
		}
		}


	immediate = {
	hidden_effect = {
		random_known_country = {
			limit = {
			has_opinion_modifier = {
				who = ROOT
				modifier = cosmo_seduced_cardinal
			}
			OR = {
					any_owned_province = {
						has_province_flag = cosmo_has_seduced_cardinal
						has_cardinal = no						
					}
			}					
			}
			remove_opinion = {
				who = ROOT
				modifier = cosmo_seduced_monarch
			}
		}
		every_province = {
			limit = {
				has_province_flag = cosmo_has_seduced_cardinal
				has_cardinal = no						
			}
			clr_province_flag = cosmo_has_seduced_cardinal
		}
		}
		}		

		mean_time_to_happen = {
			days = 1
		}		
	
	option = { #artist
		name = cosmo_brothelspy_events.82.a	
																																																
	}							
}
